title: Deliver Water to Frintford Water Tower
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Water** delivered to **Frintford Water Tower** (industry id 51, near tile 18,127).

A likely supplier is **Eastown Water Supply** (industry id 37, near tile 36,122); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **700 units** within the horizon.

**Promise:** within the first 30 game-days, commit to a delivery quantity with `rh promise quantity=N` (the last promise before the deadline counts; max 1,500). You are paid for min(delivered, promised) and fined for any shortfall, so promise what you can really deliver: over- and under-promising both cost you.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
